item.title: Horror
item.description:
People who have known me before 9th grade would know that I WAS A MFING PUSSY when it came to horror. I would get scared of the smallest things. The doll my sister owns? yes, sleeping with lights off? yes, EVEN LOOKING AT THE IMAGE OF A GHOST WOULD KEEP ME UP AT NIGHT.

However now I relish horror. During horror movie nights while others are hiding in blankets and clutching each others hands I just sit and eat chips or something Its just not that scary anymore. I am quite happy with this change. I went from a horror avoiding wuss to a horror enjoyer. I was curious about how I just went complete 180 and so I sat out with my headphone like when I do when I wanna have some sweet self reflection and so here is what I thought.

item.title: MEMES
item.description:
BAAHAHHAHAHAHA I LOVE MEMES I LOVE MEMES I LOVE MEMES

Who does not like being happy?(note - suicidal people) Everybody wants to be happy and what is the best way of expressing happiness than laughing? Humor can make a person laugh and what is the best way of spreading humor.

Even besides humor this has become a very important thing in my life. First off it is a big part of internet culture. Follow this YouTube channel called lessons in meme culture to know what I mean. Literally anything happening world wide will be turned into a meme. As of writing the Ukraine-Russia situation, “the slap” and many more things have been memed. I dont event open news sites these days, I see a meme about something and then look up what happened as this piques my interest more.
